test_title: PYST 63: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A trader sells pulses at a 32% profit and uses weights 20% less than the actual measure. Find his gain percentage.
solution:
Given:

A grocer sells rice at 32% profit and uses weights which are 20% less than the market weight

Formula used:

SP = CP(1 + P%)

P% = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100

Calculations:

Let the CP of rice be x

⇒ SP = x(1 + 32%)

⇒ SP = x(1 + 0.32)

⇒ SP = 1.32x

Faulty weights are 20% less than market ones than

Acctual weight of 1 kg weight = 1000 - 200 = 800gm

Now SP of 800gm of rice is 1.32x then

⇒ SP of 1gm of rice = 1.32x/800

⇒ SP of 1000gm rice = 1320x/800 = 1.65x

Now P% = [(1.65x - x)/x] × 100

⇒ P% = [0.65x/x] × 100

⇒ P% = 0.65 × 100 = 65%
